svg.title: P025 · Customer sign-ups by year and quarter
svg.desc: One row per sign-up year and quarter. IDs 2 and 3 both map to 2025 Q1. ID 4 maps to Q2. ID 5 has NULL year and quarter. The five customer IDs form four groups. IDs 2 and 3 count together, and ID 5 contributes one to the missing-date group. The three dated groups run chronologically, followed by NULL / NULL. Counts 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 recover all five customers. FROM Customers · one table is enough. Each customer ID represents one sign-up. The sign-up date on that row supplies its year and quarter, including the missing-date group for customer 5.
svg.text: PNP P025 / SQL WALKTHROUGH
Customer sign-ups by year and quarter
One row per sign-up year and quarter.
PREDICT THE RESULT
Where do March 31, April 1 and a missing sign-up date go?
Sample inputs
A triangle marks an example to follow. A dark source band spans its columns. ƒ marks a calculated value. Deeper cell colors mark the values to
follow. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
Customers · 5 rows
STEP 1
5 → 5 rows
What quarter does each customer enter?

g.aria-label: FROM Customers · one table is enough
g.text: FROM Customers · one table is enough
Each customer ID represents one sign-up. The sign-up date on that row supplies its year and quarter, including the

svg.text: IDs 2 and 3 both map to 2025 Q1. ID 4 maps to Q2. ID 5 has NULL year and quarter.
CAST(strftime('%Y', DateEntered) AS INTEGER) / CASE WHEN … THEN 1 … END AS signup_quarter
STEP 2
5 → 4 rows
Which keys must be grouped together?
The five customer IDs form four groups. IDs 2 and 3 count together, and ID 5 contributes one to the missing-date
group.
GROUP BY signup_year, signup_quarter

g.aria-label: Which customer IDs form each group?
g.data-table: Which customer IDs form each group?
g.text: Which customer IDs form each group?

svg.text: FINAL RESULT
4 → 4 rows
Where should the missing-date group appear?
The three dated groups run chronologically, followed by NULL / NULL. Counts 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 recover all five
customers.
ORDER BY signup_year ASC NULLS LAST, signup_quarter ASC NULLS LAST
